scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace apps/backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.db:start: docker run --name jjepjep-postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=jjepjep -e POSTGRES_USER=jjepjep -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=jjepjep_dev_password -p 5432:5432 -v jjepjep-postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data -v $PWD/infra/postgres:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro -d postgres:16-alpine
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it jjepjep-postgres psql -U jjepjep -d jjepjep
scripts.db:init: docker exec -i jjepjep-postgres psql -U jjepjep -d jjepjep -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --workspace apps/backend
